title: z-image-turbo-sda was linked to a Hugging Face model repository
summary: On 2026-03-26, the z-image-turbo-sda development line was linked to the Hugging Face repository F16/z-image-turbo-sda. This is a material public-reference step because it identifies a concrete model distribution point for the project. The dated link alone does not establish the model's capabilities, provenance, version, or release status.
